en.title: Plan AI Music for a Neighborhood Cleanup Video Without Hiding the Instructions
en.description: A practical cue plan for a volunteer cleanup video that keeps meeting points, safety details, and the next step clear.
body: A cleanup video has one job before it has any atmosphere: a new volunteer should know where to go, what to bring, and what to do when they arrive. A bright music bed can make a montage feel energetic, but it is the wrong place to compete with a meeting time, a glove reminder, or a safety note. Treat music as a frame around instructions, not a substitute for them.

## What is EasyMusic.AI?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ai-music-generator) is a platform for drafting music from prompts, lyrics, and style direction. For a community video, it can help you audition a short instrumental cue; it cannot confirm a route, assess hazards, or replace the organizer's briefing. The [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/tools/music-style-generator) can turn a loose note such as 'warm and neighborly' into a more specific starting brief.

## Build a three-part cue sheet
Use three rows: **invitation**, **on-site action**, and **final reminder**. Put a 6- to 10-second instrumental under silent shots of bags, tools, or a park sign. Fade it out before the voice says the meeting point, time, accessibility details, weather plan, or what volunteers should avoid handling. Bring a gentle cue back only for an unvoiced before-and-after sequence, then stop before the contact or registration information.

## Prompt for usefulness, not a rally
Try: `instrumental, acoustic guitar and light hand percussion, 92 BPM, friendly neighborhood energy, no vocals, simple rhythm, 8-second opening, no dramatic build, clean ending.` Make a second draft by changing one variable: remove percussion or slow the pace. Genre, instruments, tempo, vocal absence, duration, and ending are reviewable choices. A stack of adjectives is not.

## Run the phone-speaker test
Play the finished cut on a phone, then ask someone who has not joined the event to repeat the meeting point and one safety instruction. If they cannot, lower the music, create a pause, or move the words to a quieter shot. Captions and an on-screen checklist should still make sense with sound off. Ask the local organizer to review all logistical and safety information before sharing.

## Three ideas to use today
- Write the exact sentences that must be heard before generating any cue.
- Reserve music for unvoiced preparation and result shots, not instructions.
- Keep a no-music review export for the organizer.
- Make the ending point to one next action, such as a sign-up page or contact channel.

## FAQ
### Should music play while the cleanup rules are explained?
Usually no. Leave spoken rules, location details, and safety information clear.
### How many drafts should we make?
Start with two: one light rhythmic option and one simpler fallback.
### Can an AI-made track replace the volunteer briefing?
No. The organizer still needs to provide accurate local instructions and safety guidance.
### What if the video has no narration?
Use concise on-screen text, allow enough reading time, and keep the soundtrack modest.

de.title: AI-Musik fuer ein Nachbarschafts-Aufraeumvideo planen, ohne Hinweise zu verdecken
de.description: Ein praktischer Cue-Plan, damit Treffpunkt, Sicherheitshinweise und der naechste Schritt klar bleiben.
body: Ein Aufraeumvideo muss zuerst etwas leisten: Neue Helfer sollen wissen, wohin sie gehen, was sie mitbringen und was sie vor Ort tun. Musik darf Bilder rahmen, aber keinen Treffpunkt oder Sicherheitshinweis uebertoenen.

## Was ist EasyMusic.AI?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/de/ai-music-generator) ist eine Plattform fuer Musikentwuerfe aus Prompts, Lyrics und Stilrichtung. Sie kann einen kurzen instrumentalen Cue zum Anhoeren liefern, aber keine Route pruefen oder eine Einweisung ersetzen. Der [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/de/tools/music-style-generator) macht aus 'freundlich und nachbarschaftlich' einen konkreteren Startbrief.

## Drei Cue-Abschnitte
Notiere Einladung, Aktion vor Ort und Schluss-Hinweis. Lege sechs bis zehn Sekunden Instrumental unter stumme Bilder von Handschuhen, Saecken oder einem Parkschild. Vor Treffpunkt, Uhrzeit, Wetterplan, Barrierefreiheit und Sicherheitsregeln ausblenden. Musik darf bei einem stummen Vorher-nachher-Moment zurueckkommen, endet aber vor Kontakt oder Anmeldung.

## Fuer Nutzen prompten
Versuch: `instrumental, acoustic guitar and light hand percussion, 92 BPM, friendly neighborhood energy, no vocals, simple rhythm, 8-second opening, no dramatic build, clean ending.` Aendere im zweiten Entwurf nur eine Variable. Tempo, Instrumente, Vocal-Abwesenheit und Ende sind pruefbar.

## Den Handy-Test machen
Spiele den Schnitt auf einem Telefon und frage eine unbeteiligte Person nach Treffpunkt und einer Sicherheitsregel. Fehlt etwas, Cue leiser, kuerzer oder weg. Untertitel und Checkliste muessen ohne Ton Sinn ergeben. Lokale Angaben vor dem Teilen vom Organisator pruefen lassen.

## Drei Ideen fuer heute
- Schreibe alle Saetze auf, die gehoert werden muessen.
- Nutze Musik nur fuer stumme Vorbereitung und Ergebnisbilder.
- Halte einen Schnitt ohne Musik zur Freigabe bereit.
- Beende mit genau einer naechsten Handlung.

## FAQ
### Musik unter Regeln?
Meist nein; Regeln und Ortsangaben brauchen Ruhe.
### Wie viele Entwuerfe?
Zwei: eine leichte Rhythmusidee und eine einfachere Alternative.
### Ersetzt generierte Musik die Einweisung?
Nein. Der Organisator muss korrekte lokale Hinweise geben.

es.title: Planifica musica con IA para un video de limpieza vecinal sin ocultar las instrucciones
es.description: Un plan de cues para que el punto de encuentro, la seguridad y el siguiente paso sigan claros.
body: Un video de limpieza debe resolver primero algo sencillo: una persona nueva tiene que saber adonde ir, que llevar y que hacer al llegar. La musica puede enmarcar imagenes, pero no debe competir con un horario, un punto de encuentro o una indicacion de seguridad.

## Que es EasyMusic.AI?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/es/ai-music-generator) es una plataforma para crear borradores musicales desde prompts, lyrics y direccion de estilo. Puede servir para probar un cue instrumental breve; no confirma rutas ni sustituye la explicacion del organizador. El [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/es/tools/music-style-generator) concreta una idea como 'calido y de barrio'.

## Usa tres partes
Escribe invitacion, accion en el lugar y recordatorio final. Pon seis a diez segundos de instrumental bajo tomas sin voz de guantes, bolsas o un letrero. Quitala antes de decir lugar, hora, plan por clima, accesibilidad o reglas. Recuperala solo en un antes-y-despues sin voz y cortala antes del contacto.

## Pide una funcion modesta
Prueba: `instrumental, acoustic guitar and light hand percussion, 92 BPM, friendly neighborhood energy, no vocals, simple rhythm, 8-second opening, no dramatic build, clean ending.` Cambia una sola variable en la segunda version. Instrumentos, tempo, ausencia de voz y final se pueden revisar.

## Haz la prueba del telefono
Reproduce el corte en un telefono y pide a alguien que repita el punto de encuentro y una regla. Si falla, baja, acorta o elimina el cue. Subtitulos y lista en pantalla deben funcionar sin sonido. El organizador debe revisar toda informacion local antes de publicar.

## Tres ideas para hoy
- Escribe primero las frases que deben oirse.
- Reserva musica para preparacion y resultado sin voz.
- Guarda una exportacion sin musica para revisar.
- Termina con una sola accion siguiente.

## FAQ
### Musica bajo las reglas?
Normalmente no; las reglas y ubicaciones necesitan claridad.
### Cuantos borradores?
Dos suelen bastar.
### Sustituye la musica generada la charla previa?
No. El organizador debe dar indicaciones locales precisas.

fr.title: Planifier la musique IA d'une video de nettoyage de quartier sans cacher les consignes
fr.description: Un plan de cues pratique pour garder point de rendez-vous, securite et prochaine etape lisibles.
body: Une video de nettoyage doit d'abord permettre a une nouvelle personne de savoir ou aller, quoi apporter et quoi faire sur place. La musique peut encadrer les images, mais ne doit pas couvrir une heure, un lieu ou une consigne de securite.

## Qu'est-ce que EasyMusic.AI ?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/fr/ai-music-generator) est une plateforme de brouillons musicaux a partir de prompts, de paroles et de direction de style. Elle aide a essayer un court cue instrumental; elle ne verifie ni parcours ni risques et ne remplace pas le briefing. Le [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/fr/tools/music-style-generator) rend plus precis un souhait comme 'chaleureux et de quartier'.

## Trois moments
Notez invitation, action sur place et rappel final. Placez six a dix secondes d'instrumental sous des plans muets de gants, sacs ou panneau. Coupez avant le lieu, l'heure, le plan meteo, l'accessibilite et les regles. La musique peut revenir sur un avant-apres sans voix, jamais sur le contact.

## Donner une mission modeste
Essayez : `instrumental, acoustic guitar and light hand percussion, 92 BPM, friendly neighborhood energy, no vocals, simple rhythm, 8-second opening, no dramatic build, clean ending.` Ne changez qu'une variable dans le second essai. Tempo, instruments, absence de voix et fin se controlent.

## Tester au telephone
Faites ecouter sur telephone et demandez le lieu et une regle de securite. Si une information se perd, baissez, raccourcissez ou retirez le cue. Sous-titres et liste a l'ecran doivent fonctionner sans son. L'organisateur doit valider les informations locales.

## Trois idees utiles
- Ecrivez les phrases indispensables avant de generer.
- Gardez la musique pour les plans sans voix.
- Conservez une exportation sans musique pour la relecture.
- Terminez par une seule action suivante.

## FAQ
### Musique sous les consignes ?
En general non.
### Combien de brouillons ?
Deux suffisent souvent.
### La musique remplace-t-elle le briefing ?
Non, les consignes locales restent du ressort de l'organisateur.

it.title: Pianifica la musica AI per un video di pulizia di quartiere senza coprire le istruzioni
it.description: Un piano di cue pratico per mantenere chiari punto di ritrovo, sicurezza e passo successivo.
body: Un video di pulizia deve prima aiutare un nuovo volontario a capire dove andare, cosa portare e cosa fare all'arrivo. La musica puo incorniciare le immagini, ma non deve coprire orario, luogo o avviso di sicurezza.

## Che cos'e EasyMusic.AI?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/it/ai-music-generator) e una piattaforma per bozze musicali da prompt, lyrics e direzione di stile. Aiuta a provare un breve cue strumentale; non verifica percorso o rischi e non sostituisce il briefing. Il [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/it/tools/music-style-generator) rende piu concreto 'caldo e di quartiere'.

## Tre parti
Scrivi invito, azione sul posto e promemoria finale. Metti sei-dieci secondi di strumentale sotto immagini senza voce di guanti, sacchi o cartello. Fallo sparire prima di luogo, ora, meteo, accessibilita e regole. Puo tornare solo su un prima-dopo senza voce, e finire prima del contatto.

## Dai un compito sobrio
Prova: `instrumental, acoustic guitar and light hand percussion, 92 BPM, friendly neighborhood energy, no vocals, simple rhythm, 8-second opening, no dramatic build, clean ending.` Nella seconda bozza cambia una variabile. Strumenti, tempo, assenza di voce e finale sono verificabili.

## Test sul telefono
Fallo ascoltare su telefono e chiedi luogo e una regola. Se manca qualcosa, abbassa, accorcia o rimuovi il cue. Sottotitoli e lista a schermo devono funzionare senza audio. L'organizzatore deve controllare le informazioni locali.

## Tre idee per oggi
- Scrivi prima le frasi indispensabili.
- Riserva la musica ai piani senza voce.
- Conserva un export senza musica per la revisione.
- Chiudi con una sola azione successiva.

## FAQ
### Musica sotto le regole?
Di solito no.
### Quante bozze?
Due spesso bastano.
### Sostituisce il briefing?
No; le istruzioni locali spettano all'organizzatore.

pt.title: Planeje musica AI para video de mutirao de limpeza sem esconder as instrucoes
pt.description: Um plano de cues pratico para manter local, seguranca e proximo passo claros.
body: Um video de mutirao precisa primeiro ajudar uma pessoa nova a saber onde ir, o que levar e o que fazer ao chegar. A musica pode enquadrar imagens, mas nao deve disputar horario, ponto de encontro ou aviso de seguranca.

## O que e EasyMusic.AI?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/pt/ai-music-generator) e uma plataforma para rascunhos musicais com prompts, lyrics e direcao de estilo. Ajuda a testar um cue instrumental curto; nao confirma rota, risco ou substitui a orientacao. O [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/pt/tools/music-style-generator) deixa mais concreto algo como 'calor humano de vizinhanca'.

## Tres partes
Anote convite, acao no local e lembrete final. Use seis a dez segundos de instrumental sob imagens sem voz de luvas, sacos ou placa. Tire antes de local, horario, plano de clima, acessibilidade e regras. A musica pode voltar somente num antes-e-depois sem voz e termina antes do contato.

## Peca um trabalho modesto
Tente: `instrumental, acoustic guitar and light hand percussion, 92 BPM, friendly neighborhood energy, no vocals, simple rhythm, 8-second opening, no dramatic build, clean ending.` Na segunda versao, mude uma variavel. Instrumentos, tempo, ausencia de voz e final sao escolhas revisaveis.

## Teste no telefone
Toque no telefone e peca a alguem o ponto de encontro e uma regra. Se perder algo, abaixe, encurte ou retire o cue. Legendas e lista na tela devem funcionar sem som. O organizador deve revisar dados locais.

## Tres ideias para hoje
- Escreva as frases que precisam ser ouvidas.
- Reserve musica para imagens sem voz.
- Guarde uma versao sem musica para revisao.
- Termine com uma unica proxima acao.

## FAQ
### Musica sob regras?
Em geral nao.
### Quantos rascunhos?
Dois costumam bastar.
### Substitui a orientacao?
Nao. O organizador ainda deve dar instrucoes locais.

ru.title: Как спланировать AI music для видео о районной уборке, не скрывая инструкции
ru.description: Практичный план cues, чтобы место встречи, безопасность и следующий шаг были ясны.
body: Видео об уборке прежде всего должно помочь новому volunteer понять, куда идти, что взять и что делать по прибытии. Music может обрамлять кадры, но не должна конкурировать со временем, местом встречи или safety note.

## Что такое EasyMusic.AI?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ru/ai-music-generator) — платформа для music drafts из prompts, lyrics и style direction. Она помогает прослушать короткий instrumental cue; она не проверяет маршрут, риски и не заменяет briefing. [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ru/tools/music-style-generator) уточняет идею вроде 'friendly neighborhood energy'.

## Три части
Запишите invitation, action on site и final reminder. Поставьте шесть-десять секунд instrumental под немые кадры перчаток, мешков или знака. Уберите до места, времени, погодного плана, accessibility и rules. Music может вернуться только на немом до-после и закончиться до контакта.

## Дайте prompt скромную задачу
Попробуйте: `instrumental, acoustic guitar and light hand percussion, 92 BPM, friendly neighborhood energy, no vocals, simple rhythm, 8-second opening, no dramatic build, clean ending.` Во втором draft поменяйте одну переменную. Instruments, tempo, отсутствие vocals и ending можно проверить.

## Проверьте на phone
Включите на phone и попросите повторить meeting point и одно safety rule. Если что-то потерялось, сделайте cue тише, короче или уберите. Captions и экранный список должны работать без sound. Organiser должен проверить местную информацию.

## Три идеи на сегодня
- Сначала напишите фразы, которые нужно услышать.
- Оставьте music для кадров без речи.
- Сохраните версию без music для проверки.
- Завершите одним next action.

## FAQ
### Music под правилами?
Обычно нет.
### Сколько drafts?
Часто хватает двух.
### Заменяет ли она briefing?
Нет. Местные инструкции дает организатор.

zh.title: 为社区清洁活动视频规划 AI 音乐，而不遮住关键信息
zh.description: 一份实用 cue 计划，让集合地点、安全提示和下一步保持清晰。
body: 清洁活动视频首先要解决一个实际问题：新志愿者要知道去哪里、带什么、到了做什么。音乐可以衬托画面，但不能与时间、集合地点或安全提示竞争。

## 什么是 EasyMusic.AI？
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/zh/ai-music-generator) 是一个根据 prompts、lyrics 和 style direction 制作 music drafts 的平台。它可以用于试听简短的 instrumental cue；不能确认路线、评估风险或替代组织者 briefing。[Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/zh/tools/music-style-generator) 能把“温暖、有邻里感”变成更具体的起始 brief。

## 做三段 cue sheet
写下 invitation、on-site action 和 final reminder。可在手套、垃圾袋或公园标志的无声镜头下放 6–10 秒 instrumental。讲到 meeting point、time、weather plan、accessibility 或 safety rules 前淡出。音乐只在无声的 before-and-after 段落回归，并在 contact information 前结束。

## 给 prompt 一个克制任务
可试：`instrumental, acoustic guitar and light hand percussion, 92 BPM, friendly neighborhood energy, no vocals, simple rhythm, 8-second opening, no dramatic build, clean ending.` 第二版只改一个变量。instruments、tempo、无 vocals 和 ending 都是可审查的选择。

## 做 phone speaker 测试
在 phone 上播放，请没参加过活动的人复述 meeting point 和一条 safety instruction。若没听清，就降低、缩短或移除 cue。captions 和 screen checklist 在 sound off 时也应成立。发布前请组织者核对所有本地信息。

## 今天就能用的三个想法
- 生成前写出必须听清的句子。
- 音乐只留给无声的准备和成果镜头。
- 为组织者保留 no-music review export。
- 结尾只指向一个 next action。

## FAQ
### 解释规则时要放 music 吗？
通常不要。规则和地点需要清晰。
### 要做几版？
两版通常足够。
### generated music 能替代 briefing 吗？
不能。组织者仍需提供准确的本地说明。

ja.title: 案内を隠さない地域清掃動画用AI music cue plan
ja.description: 集合場所、安全情報、次の行動を明確に保つ実用的なcue planです。
body: 地域清掃のvideoは、初めてのvolunteerがどこへ行き、何を持ち、到着後に何をするかを分かるようにすることが先です。musicは映像を支えられますが、時間、meeting point、safety noteと競争させません。

## EasyMusic.AIとは？
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ja/ai-music-generator) はprompts、lyrics、style directionからmusic draftsを作るプラットフォームです。短いinstrumental cueを試せますが、routeやriskを確認したりbriefingを置き換えたりしません。[Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ja/tools/music-style-generator) は「warm and neighborly」のようなnoteをより具体的なbriefにします。

## 三つのcueに分ける
invitation、on-site action、final reminderを書きます。gloves、bags、park signの無言の映像には6〜10秒のinstrumentalを置けます。meeting point、time、weather plan、accessibility、safety rulesの前にfade outします。musicは無言のbefore-and-afterでだけ戻し、contact informationの前に終えます。

## 控えめなjobをpromptに書く
例：`instrumental, acoustic guitar and light hand percussion, 92 BPM, friendly neighborhood energy, no vocals, simple rhythm, 8-second opening, no dramatic build, clean ending.` 二つ目のdraftでは一つだけ変えます。instruments、tempo、no vocals、endingは確認できる指定です。

## phoneでtestする
phoneで再生し、参加経験のない人にmeeting pointとsafety instructionを一つ復唱してもらいます。伝わらなければcueを下げ、短くするか外します。captionsとscreen checklistはsound offでも機能させます。公開前にorganizerがlocal informationを確認します。

## 今日使える三つのideas
- 先に必ず聞こえるべきsentenceを書く。
- musicは無言の準備と結果の映像だけに使う。
- organizer用にno-music exportを残す。
- endingは一つのnext actionに絞る。

## FAQ
### rulesの下にmusicは？
通常は不要です。
### draftsはいくつ？
二つで十分なことが多いです。
### generated musicはbriefingを置き換えますか？
いいえ。local instructionsはorganizerが出す必要があります。

ko.title: 안내를 가리지 않는 동네 정화 영상용 AI music cue plan
ko.description: 집결지, 안전 정보, 다음 행동을 또렷하게 남기는 실용적인 cue plan입니다.
body: 동네 정화 video는 처음 오는 volunteer가 어디로 가고, 무엇을 가져가며, 도착해서 무엇을 할지 알게 하는 일이 먼저입니다. music은 화면을 받칠 수 있지만 시간, meeting point, safety note와 경쟁하면 안 됩니다.

## EasyMusic.AI란?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ko/ai-music-generator)는 prompts, lyrics, style direction으로 music drafts를 만드는 플랫폼입니다. 짧은 instrumental cue를 시험할 수 있지만 route나 risk를 확인하거나 briefing을 대신하지는 않습니다. [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ko/tools/music-style-generator)는 'warm and neighborly' 같은 note를 더 구체적인 brief로 만듭니다.

## 세 cue로 나누기
invitation, on-site action, final reminder를 적습니다. gloves, bags, park sign의 무성 화면에는 6~10초 instrumental을 둘 수 있습니다. meeting point, time, weather plan, accessibility, safety rules 전에 fade out합니다. music은 무성 before-and-after에서만 돌아오고 contact information 전에 끝냅니다.

## prompt에 절제된 job 쓰기
예: `instrumental, acoustic guitar and light hand percussion, 92 BPM, friendly neighborhood energy, no vocals, simple rhythm, 8-second opening, no dramatic build, clean ending.` 두 번째 draft에서는 한 변수만 바꾸세요. instruments, tempo, no vocals, ending은 확인 가능한 지시입니다.

## phone에서 test하기
phone으로 틀고 참여 경험이 없는 사람에게 meeting point와 safety instruction 하나를 말해 달라고 하세요. 놓치면 cue를 낮추거나 짧게 하거나 뺍니다. captions과 screen checklist는 sound off에서도 작동해야 합니다. 공개 전 organizer가 local information을 확인해야 합니다.

## 오늘 쓸 세 ideas
- 먼저 꼭 들려야 할 sentence를 씁니다.
- music은 무성 준비와 결과 화면에만 둡니다.
- organizer 검토용 no-music export를 남깁니다.
- ending은 하나의 next action만 가리킵니다.

## FAQ
### rules 아래 music?
보통은 아닙니다.
### drafts는 몇 개?
두 개면 충분한 경우가 많습니다.
### generated music이 briefing을 대신하나요?
아닙니다. local instructions는 organizer가 제공해야 합니다.

ar.title: خطط لموسيقى AI لفيديو تنظيف الحي من دون اخفاء التعليمات
ar.description: خطة cues عملية تبقي مكان اللقاء والسلامة والخطوة التالية واضحة.
body: يجب ان يساعد فيديو تنظيف الحي المتطوع الجديد اولا على معرفة اين يذهب وماذا يحضر وماذا يفعل عند الوصول. يمكن ان تساند music الصور، لكنها لا ينبغي ان تنافس الوقت او مكان اللقاء او safety note.

## ما هي EasyMusic.AI؟
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ar/ai-music-generator) منصة لصنع music drafts من prompts وlyrics وstyle direction. تساعد في تجربة instrumental cue قصير؛ لكنها لا تؤكد route او risks ولا تستبدل briefing المنظم. يجعل [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ar/tools/music-style-generator) فكرة مثل 'warm and neighborly' brief اوضح.

## استخدم ثلاثة cues
اكتب invitation وon-site action وfinal reminder. ضع ستا الى عشر ثوان من instrumental تحت صور صامتة للقفازات او الاكياس او لافتة الحديقة. اخفها قبل meeting point وtime وweather plan وaccessibility وsafety rules. يمكن ان تعود music فقط في before-and-after صامت وتنتهي قبل contact information.

## اعط prompt وظيفة متواضعة
جرب: `instrumental, acoustic guitar and light hand percussion, 92 BPM, friendly neighborhood energy, no vocals, simple rhythm, 8-second opening, no dramatic build, clean ending.` غير متغيرا واحدا في draft الثاني. instruments وtempo وno vocals وending خيارات قابلة للمراجعة.

## اختبر على phone
شغله على phone واطلب من شخص لم يشارك ان يكرر meeting point وتعليمة safety واحدة. اذا ضاعت معلومة، اخفض cue او اختصره او احذفه. يجب ان تعمل captions وscreen checklist مع sound off. على organizer مراجعة كل local information قبل النشر.

## ثلاث ideas لليوم
- اكتب اولا كل sentence يجب سماعه.
- اترك music للقطات التحضير والنتيجة الصامتة.
- احتفظ بno-music export للمراجعة.
- اختم بnext action واحد.

## FAQ
### music تحت rules؟
غالبا لا.
### كم draft؟
اثنان يكفيان غالبا.
### هل تحل generated music محل briefing؟
لا. على organizer تقديم local instructions دقيقة.
